facts.text: I am preparing for the upcoming Harvest Market on September 18th.
I need help organizing my sales data from previous markets.
I sold 20 soaps at the weekly farmers' market on July 17th.
I sold 15 soaps at the SummerFest market on July 24th.
I sold 15 candles at the weekly farmers' market.
I sold 30 candles at the SummerFest market.
I made $250 at the weekly farmers' market.
I made $420 at the SummerFest market.
I want to use the data to determine the best products to bring to the Harvest Market.
I am considering focusing on soaps, candles, or a mix of both for the Harvest Market.
I will use a balanced product mix with a slight emphasis on candles.
I have been getting great feedback on my pumpkin spice candle.
I think the pumpkin spice candle is a great fit for the Harvest Market.
I am thinking of offering a discount for customers who buy both a soap and a candle together.
I want to decide how much of a discount to offer for buying a soap and a candle together.
